about: Questions on the Parcel tab and Be prepared (Nov 21), and on areas picked on a boundary and the district tables (Nov 22): parcel facts, district yards, height and coverage, flags, property tax, documents, offices, what to bring and ask, county, tract and ZIP code answers, and two general passages. Made by agent/eval/make_parcel_questions.ts: expected values read from tool results. Do not edit by hand.
